Name: Ben-Hadad I, King of Syria
Summary: Ben-Hadad, son of Tabrimon and grandson of Hezion, king of Syria, took Asa's silver and gold and attacked Baasha's cities, breaking his league with Israel.
KeyStory: Ben-Hadad I breaks with Baasha for Asa.
RelatedPeople: King Asa; Baasha, King of Israel; Tabrimon, Father of Ben-Hadad I
LifeLesson: Bought allies fight for the payer, not for the cause.
